findings.claim: Q3 2026 room nights 345M, +7% YoY; gross bookings $54.5B, +10%; reported revenue $8.9B, -1% (FTC-related revenue reduction), adjusted revenue $9.8B, +9%

Q4 2026 guidance: room nights +1% to +3%, gross bookings +2% to +4% (4%-6% constant currency); management cited Middle East disruption, higher airfares, localized European unrest and softer international travel late in Q3, assumed to persist through year-end
Room night growth trend 2026: Q1 +6% (Middle East conflict est. ~2pp drag), Q2 +5%, Q3 +7%; 2025 full-year +8% driven by Europe and Asia
findings.source: Booking Holdings Q1/Q2 2026 earnings releases via search summary

findings.claim: Skift (May 2026) reported Booking lost ~6M room nights to the Iran war, grew room nights 6% vs 8% projected, and noted U.S. market share gain likely at Expedia's expense (secondary aggregator summary)

note: Per-segment (merchant/agency/flights/ads) revenue split, Airbnb share, and TAM consensus not found with sourced figures; excerpts are not verbatim (search summaries only).
